data.long_meaning: The name Vibhu is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Vibhu', which means 'God', 'Lord', or 'Powerful'. In Hindu mythology, Vibhu is an epithet for various deities, particularly Shiva and Vishnu. The name Vibhu carries the meaning “God, Lord, Powerful” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. Parents who choose Vibhu usually hope their child will grow to embody god, lord, powerful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
